**Variation warrant, 8 October 2026.** [The new module](VariationWarrant.lean) derives the exact post-correlation endpoint domain from the unchanged process, then proves arbitrary finite continuation/outcome correspondence and support tests on attained preparations. **19 new theorems / 21 empty audits**, with 59 unchanged inherited audits, pass in the [source-bound receipt](variation-warrant-checks/20261007T234515.871133Z/receipt.json). [Formal scope](../../../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/VARIATION-WARRANT-FORMAL.md) retains native-law/phase inputs, off-diagonal histories before formation, and provenance lost by endpoint normalization.

## Claim-specific warrant and derived variation

The [new warrant account](SYSTEM-WARRANT.md) follows Ren's question about whether identified relations and admitted variations characterize actual systems. It gives positive grounds through formation, actual uptake, provenance, supported realization and constraints. Historical occurrence, present capability, universal exclusion and exact possibility claims require different coverage; an exhaustive domain is not a universal prerequisite for every narrower claim. This clarifies a possible overstrong reading without attributing an infallibility demand to the earlier account.

The [Lean continuation](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/VARIATION-WARRANT-INTEGRATION.md) derives the previously supplied post-formation domain from unchanged native operations: every endpoint satisfies the invariant and every member has a concrete preparation. Arbitrary finite later words and endpoint questions are preserved. Nineteen new theorems / 21 empty declaration audits pass, with 59 inherited audits unchanged. The fixed law, carrier and selected phase remain explicit.

These results supply a justified local domain and a more precise account of actual warrant. They do not yet justify the root's substantive universal commitments or all recognition and inference without remaining assumptions. A general warrant procedure is not an automatic guarantee that every attribution is correct; actual, defeasible grounds are nevertheless grounds. The stronger target remains active, with no impossibility claim or cancellation of the separate completed ethical route.

## Grounding the range of variation

8 October 2026. [The next warrant study](SYSTEM-WARRANT.md) derives the earlier example's post-formation comparison domain from its actual formal preparation and continuation. **19 new theorems / 21 empty audits** prove exact endpoint coverage and arbitrary finite continuation/outcome correspondence; 59 inherited audits retain their maps. The unchanged process and selected phase remain local inputs.

The account distinguishes witnessed occurrence, currently supported capability, justified universal constraints and exact possibility characterizations. Each needs the appropriate direction of coverage. Documented control and biological preparation supply actual scoped evidence; neither past success nor absence from a protocol guarantees future feasibility or impossibility. [Argument, primary review and checks](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/VARIATION-WARRANT-INTEGRATION.md) preserve observational routes to warrant and the stronger unfinished foundation.

## 关系与变化的根据 / Warrant for relationships and variation

2026-10-08。仅 C01 成对接入[本轮论证与证明](VARIATION-WARRANT-INTEGRATION.md)，保留上轮27项系统定理及全部更早范围；新增19项定理／21项空审计，59项继承声明按原表复查。实际发生、当前能力、普遍限制与精确可能性分别取得所需覆盖。/ The previous systems chapter and accepted review bytes are preserved. Only the owned new pages enter discovery, and eight shared-file insertions receive scoped records. [Checks](VARIATION-WARRANT-CHECKS.json) bind final reviewed documents, proof sources/receipts, original evidence, links and C01. Other rows and generated lines are preserved; concurrent source review is not certified. No automation, full catalogue rebuild or unrelated scientific rerun is introduced.

C01.title_zh: 同一生成展开与关系分化
C01.title_en: One generative unfolding and relational differentiation
C01.claim_zh: 活动形成并转化后续活动的条件；组织、认识、行动与评价在同一展开中分化，并通过实际相连的机制及其对应得到说明。 系统通过实际关系辨认，边界须保留相关依存；预测充分性与构成参与分别说明。
C01.claim_en: Activity forms and transforms conditions of further activity; organization, knowing, action and evaluation differentiate within one unfolding and are explained through connected mechanisms and their correspondence. Systems are identified through actual relations; boundaries retain relevant dependencies, with predictive sufficiency distinguished from constitutive participation.
C01.scope_zh: 相连说明在条件范围内已完成；无假设目标继续。既有11项有限重演定理之外，持续阶段25项新定理、27项声明审计；构成可证源对应并传递至复合项，实际适用、逻辑／识别根据与普遍范围仍待证成。 直接构成论证保留已辨认关系的必要内容，排除同一架构普遍实现的额外门槛；全目标域的归属与覆盖尚未证成。本轮无新定理。 后续系统研究新增27项定理／41项空依赖声明审计，另18项继承审计：联合可接纳域中两个充分区域可以没有最小共同支持。最小性限可判定子区域，无最小支持结论不限。形成域内的有限词可行性已证；实际构成及更强普遍根据仍开放。
C01.scope_en: Connected articulation complete at conditional scope; assumption-free grounding continues. Beyond 11 earlier finite-replay theorems, the sustained investigation has 25 new theorems and 27 audits. Construction can prove source links and propagate correspondence; actual applicability, logical/recognitional warrant and universal scope remain open. The direct constitutive argument preserves established relational content and rejects universal use of one architecture as an extra gate; full-scope attribution and coverage remain unestablished. No new theorem in this assessment. The subsequent systems study adds 27 theorems / 41 empty declaration audits plus 18 inherited audits: joint admissibility can allow two sufficient regions with no least support. Minimality is among decidable subregions; absence of a least support is unrestricted. Formed-domain finite-word feasibility is proved; actual constitution and stronger universal warrant remain open.
